author: Aaronjacobs000
notes: In Prism Central, add the data collector as a remote syslog server (Settings > Syslog Server) and send the Audit module at INFO and the Security Policy Hit Logs module; turn on policy hit logs in each Flow Network Security policy you want logged. Audit lines (VM, category and security policy changes, from Prism Central) go to CloudAudit: alertUid as event_name, operationType as event_type, the user and the record uuid, with the description, first affected entity, cluster and operation times in additional_event_data and params as JSON text in request_parameters. Policy hit logs (from each AHV host) go to Netflow: addresses, ports, protocol, ALLOW and MONITOR as allowed and DROP as blocked, direction, ORIG counts as tx and REPLY counts as rx, with the policy name and UUID and the session state (New, Update, Destroy) in event_metadata. Count New events for hits and add up Destroy events for traffic. The hit time has no zone and is read as UTC. Lines from older releases, with no DIRECTION and a flow-hitCountN tag, also match. Not covered: the API Audit module, whose line format Nutanix doesn't publish, and the Flow Service, Calm and Epsilon service logs. Nutanix doesn't publish the layout of the login and IAM audit records that Prism Central 7.6 added, so check those in Parse Message. Samples follow the field names in Nutanix's syslog module tables and the hit log layout in the Nutanix Bible and on the Nutanix developer blog, with made-up values. Passed Run Test in a lab tenant on 2026-10-14 (127 of 127 fields matched the emulator in each of 3 runs, and neither parser claimed the other's lines), and no built-in parser claimed these lines in 6 Run Tests.
